ابتلعتا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَلَعَتَا (ibtalaʕatā) /ib.ta.la.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# اُبْتُلِعَتَا (ubtuliʕatā) /ub.tu.li.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
